components.name: Main action
components.description: Start or continue: one filled ivory action with warm hover and amber focus.
components.css: .ds-menu{display:flex;align-items:center;position:relative;min-height:48px;width:100%;margin:0;padding:10px 18px;border:0;background:none;box-shadow:none;color:#c6cbd0;font-size:17px;letter-spacing:0;line-height:1.5;text-align:left;transition:background-color .16s,color .16s,padding-left .16s;font-family:var(--f-body,"Yahaeng UI","Apple SD Gothic Neo","Malgun Gothic",sans-serif);font-weight:400;border-radius:0;cursor:pointer;}.ds-menu::after{content:"";position:absolute;right:17px;width:6px;height:6px;border:solid currentColor;border-width:1px 1px 0 0;transform:rotate(45deg);opacity:0;transition:opacity .16s,right .16s}.ds-menu:hover,.ds-menu:focus-visible{background:#d4deea12;color:#f6f0df;padding-left:24px}.ds-menu:hover::after,.ds-menu:focus-visible::after{opacity:1;right:20px}.ds-menu:focus-visible{outline:2px solid #ecb66e;outline-offset:3px}.ds-menu:active{background:#bccaD41f}.ds-primary{min-height:60px;margin-bottom:16px;padding:14px 44px 14px 18px;color:#101820;background:#e6e3d6;font-size:19px;border:1px solid #faf4dc}.ds-primary::after{opacity:1;right:20px}.ds-primary:hover,.ds-primary:focus-visible{background:#f3d5a3;color:#101820}.ds-primary:active{background:#bccaD41f}.ds-primary:disabled{background:#687178;border-color:#899095;color:#121b23;opacity:1;cursor:default}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-menu,.ds-menu::after{transition:none}}

narrative.overview:
The entrance belongs to the game's Korean night alley. Pixel buildings, Hangul shop neon, a warm outdoor lamp, and the small player character establish the place. A compact ivory title and a quiet vertical menu occupy its shadow. The player's next action is immediate and legible.

This is a scan of the implemented main menu, its settings surface, and restart confirmation. It is not a specification for every existing game screen. The current game HUD, skill tree, mission screens, and simulation behavior retain their own implementation; their incidental defects are not visual rules. The user's chosen world and the existing game assets constrain this front end.
keyCharacteristics: Actual game scenery with crisp pixel rendering.
Dark opaque reading surfaces and pale Korean typography.
One prominent ivory action, with warm interaction feedback.
Square controls and a restrained steel frame on utility surfaces.
Responsive composition that keeps starting or continuing accessible.

rules.name: The Reading Surface Rule
rules.body: Keep utility text on the opaque ink panel. Let scenery remain visible around it; do not let its details compete through the reading surface.

dos: **Do** preserve the confirmed pixel alley, Hangul neon, and concise menu direction.
**Do** keep the title fully readable and the start/continue action visible at supported viewport sizes.
**Do** use the actual two title assets, preserve pixel edges, and retain their staged-render provenance.
**Do** keep utility reading surfaces opaque and keyboard focus visible.
**Do** preserve the current save-state menu hierarchy and PC/touch access.
donts: **Don't** replace the alley with a newly illustrated character poster or oversized clipped title.
**Don't** add rounded floating cards around the main menu; its current container is open over the scene.
**Don't** treat staged title lighting or roof composition as proof of gameplay behavior.
**Don't** apply this front-end scan wholesale to the older HUD, skill tree, mission screens, or simulation defects.
